description_zh: 後端知識庫安全強化：針對 public API、internal API、admin API、source claim vault 與 AI article workflow 的安全政策。

auth: Internal/admin endpoints require API key or admin session
HMAC signature recommended for article draft validation requests
API client scopes must be checked before source packet resolve / publish check
data_access: Sensitive source notes, review notes, rejected records, blocked_license records are never exposed to public or frontend composer
Source claim packets use allowlist categories and release_channel grants
Row visibility depends on visibility, review_status, sensitivity, source_license_state
prompt_injection: Source claims are data, not instructions
Frontend prompt must wrap user idea and source claims in separated sections
Backend validation rejects drafts that claim source support for user-only opinions
Backend validation rejects drafts containing ritual procedure instruction patterns
observability: All internal AI article checks produce audit events
Source pack downloads by client_id are logged
Duplicate and publish checks store fingerprints but not raw private prompts unless configured
